THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands describedbelow are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

The allotments of lands shown as Lot Nos. 1 to 11 in total extentof about 0.0950 Hectare, depicted in Advance Tracing No. CO/KLN/2014/919 and dated 06.08.2015, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village of Orugodawatta (Urban CouncilLimits of Kolonnawa) in the Divisional Secretary’s Division ofKolonnawa in the District of Colombo in the Western Province andbounded as follows:

1. Lot 'A' – Assmt. No. 455, Awissawella Road – Extent:0.0009 HectareNorth: Land of Assmt. No. 455, Awissawella Road; East: Land ofAssmt. No. 455, Awissawella Road and Lot B; South: Lot B andColombo - Awissawella Road; West: Colombo - Awissawella Roadand Land of Assmt. No. 455, Awissawella Road.

2. Lot 'B' – Assmt. No. 461/B, Awissawella Road – Extent:0.0086 HectareNorth: Lot A, Land of Assmt. Nos. 455 and 461/B, AwissawellaRoad; East: Land of Assmt. Nos. 461/B, 462, Awissawella Road andLot C; South: Lot C and Colombo - Awissawella Road; West: Colombo- Awissawella Road and Lot A.
